acceptance: Write the approved architecture as the sole authoritative specification: responsibilities, lifecycle, invariants, failure semantics, deletion map, acceptance budgets, rollout and rollback. Historical incidents are validation cases, not constraints that preserve old mechanisms.

Replace full-board-per-event hot storage with a compact current-head snapshot plus append-only transition deltas. Append and fsync the delta before atomically replacing the head; crash recovery may replay only the tail after the head sequence.

Freeze the existing multi-gigabyte journal as a read-only archive with exact byte length, final sequence, journal SHA and projected state SHA. Bind the v2 genesis record to that archive identity; never delete historical evidence during migration.
Normal reads must not mmap, hash or parse the archived journal. Full chain verification is startup/offline verification and may not execute inside a scheduling tick or canonical mutation.
Keep one task-state lock and one transaction API. Reject nonterminal task loss, invalid deltas, sequence conflicts, corrupted tails and stale head CAS.
Delete the v1 full-state append/replay/checkpoint hot path and its obsolete tests in the same PR. Do not retain a production feature flag or automatic fallback to v1.
Add migration, corruption, crash-boundary and constant-hot-read-cost tests using a synthetic large legacy journal. Report gross deletions, additions and remaining production callers.
Deliver from a clean task worktree to dev with required trailers, focused and full task-store validation, independent exact-head review and required checks.

handoffs.message: V2 delta store, architecture spec, migration/offline verifier, and committed review manifest are ready on PR #4757. Verify exact head 4f79db4ce17635a2f02b3a26b7bcb78bb19d6610; focused validation recorded: 119 passed, with one origin/dev baseline legacy-card test excluded.

Exact-head review of PR #4757 at 4f79db4ce17635a2f02b3a26b7bcb78bb19d6610 requires changes: (1) _state_delta replaces the entire tasks list whenever its length changes; adding one row to a 1,200-task board produced a 99,105-byte event versus a 98,493-byte full state. Implement compact insert/remove semantics for task materialization/archive and add a large-board row-count-change test. (2) Resume after archive rename must re-enforce read-only permissions; a simulated crash before chmod resumed as migrated with mode 0644. (3) When archive and manifest already exist, migration must compare actual byte length, final sequence, journal SHA, and projected-state SHA to the manifest and fail before writing genesis on mismatch; current migration succeeds and only full verify fails later. (4) verify_full_chain must accept and validate a durable valid post-head crash tail or settle/reconcile it consistently; current load_snapshot recovers one valid tail while verify_full_chain rejects the same store as head disagreement. Add focused regression tests for all four boundaries. Existing independent suite: 119 passed, 1 deselected.

PR #4757 is updated at exact head 602685bb81b8d8814cd2580a391742f5e54b15b3. Review committed docs/deployment/evidence/supervisor/SUP-AUTHORITY-V2-TASK-STORE-20260811/evidence.json, V2 explicit observational-read migration, and 126 passed / 1 deselected focused validation; approve with REVIEW_PR=4757 and REVIEW_HEAD_SHA=602685bb81b8d8814cd2580a391742f5e54b15b3.

Exact-head PR #4757 review at 602685bb81b8d8814cd2580a391742f5e54b15b3 found an acceptance-blocking migration scalability defect: _read_legacy_journal calls _read_regular_bytes, retains the entire legacy journal, then payload.splitlines retains another full-journal-scale allocation while parsing. The required 8.65 GB archive migration can therefore require well above 17 GB before decoded event/state overhead and is not a viable bounded migration. Replace legacy archive validation with an O(max-record/state), streaming regular-file reader that computes exact byte length and SHA incrementally while preserving O_NOFOLLOW, complete-record, sequence/hash-chain and projected-state validation; use it for dry-run, initial migration, resume and offline archive verification. Add a regression proving the legacy path does not aggregate full journal bytes plus an explicit migration memory budget/evidence for a realistically large synthetic journal, refresh the committed evidence manifest, rerun focused validation, and request fresh exact-head review. Independent current-head checks otherwise passed: 126 passed, 1 deselected; py_compile, JSON validation and git diff --check passed.
